title: TFLN waveguide coupled to a ring resonator

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: source centre wavelength

parameters.name: w_wg
parameters.description: bus and ring waveguide width

parameters.name: r_ring
parameters.description: ring radius (centre line)

parameters.name: gap
parameters.description: bus-to-ring edge-to-edge gap

parameters.name: margin
parameters.description: cladding between the structure and the PML

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: domain width; the bus runs along x

parameters.name: y_bus
parameters.description: bus centre line

parameters.name: y_ring
parameters.description: ring centre y

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: domain height

parameters.name: x_source
parameters.description: source line position

parameters.name: x_input
parameters.description: input flux line, between the source and the ring

parameters.name: x_through
parameters.description: through-port flux line

parameters.name: half_span
parameters.description: half length of the source and flux lines across the bus

parameters.name: w_mode
parameters.description: 1/e field half-width of the bus mode (slab mode solver of tfln_ring_resonator.py)

parameters.name: n_eff
parameters.description: effective index of the bus mode at lambda0

parameters.name: core_fraction
parameters.description: fraction of the mode power inside the core

parameters.name: round_trip_loss
parameters.description: artificial power loss fraction per ring round trip (near critical coupling; 0 = lossless)

parameters.name: sigma_ring
parameters.description: ring conductivity in S/m giving round_trip_loss

parameters.name: lambda_min
parameters.description: shortest wavelength of the flux spectra

parameters.name: lambda_max
parameters.description: longest wavelength of the flux spectra

parameters.name: dft_half_range
parameters.description: the field maps cover lambda0 +- this, a little over one free spectral range (35 nm)

parameters.name: t_run
parameters.description: run time: pulse plus the ring-down
